title: Selling a Houston House With an Open HELOC
description: Selling with a Houston HELOC? Separate the balance, payoff quote, account closure and lien release before relying on your estimated sale proceeds.
author: CashAsIs

faq.q: Can I sell a Houston house with an open HELOC?
faq.a: Usually, an open HELOC does not by itself prevent a sale. Tell the closing team about it early so the lender's payoff, account-closure and lien requirements can be addressed for the transaction.

faq.q: Does a zero HELOC balance prove the account is closed?
faq.a: No. A revolving credit line can have no current balance and still be open. Confirm account status and what the lender and closing team require rather than treating the balance screen as title clearance.

faq.q: Should I subtract the HELOC credit limit from the sale price?
faq.a: The credit limit is not the same as the amount owed. Use a current payoff quote and the closing team's complete estimate of transaction costs to evaluate expected proceeds.

faq.q: Does a cash offer remove a HELOC lien?
faq.a: No. A cash purchase does not replace lender or title requirements. Compare the offer and responsibilities while the appropriate professionals confirm how the credit line will be handled.

substantiveDifference: An open revolving line may permit further borrowing at zero balance. This guide distinguishes credit limit, borrowed balance, payoff quote, authorization to close and lien handling. Existing mortgage-release guide concerns a previously paid closed loan, not an active line.
